760	Hello Rabbi, I went on vacation with my family
761	up north and we looked for a restaurant. I wanted to eat
762	at a place with a kashrut certificate, and the rest of the family didn't see
763	any importance in it, since everyone is Jewish. How much
764	of a significant consideration is this when choosing a place to eat?
765	The matter of kashrut,
766	even in places where it is hard to find a kosher place, such as
767	in certain regions abroad,
768	requires being especially careful about it.
769	The Kabbalah sages point out that when a person eats, the body
770	is nourished by the physical substance in the food, and the soul receives the
771	spiritual part of the food.
772	When Elokim tells us in the Torah, "Eat this and this
773	do not eat," He reveals to you the secrets of the nature of
774	Creation from the spiritual dimension. He tells you, "This,
775	if you eat it, will not harm you. This suits the body
776	and also suits the soul. That is not good." Today it has also been proven
777	in many fields that what is not kosher is also not healthy.
778	But let us leave health aside for a moment. From the spiritual aspect,
779	a person must be careful with himself, to say: I do not
780	bring into myself things that will pollute the spiritual part
781	within me. The verse says, "And do not defile yourselves with any of these,"
782	with the things forbidden to eat, "that you should be defiled by them." The word
783	"venitmetem" should be written with an aleph in the middle, like
784	"tamé." In the Torah it is written without an aleph: "venitmetem."
785	Our Sages explain why no aleph: as is known, the letter aleph
786	represents Elokim, and a person who eats non-kosher food,
787	so to speak, Elokim departs from there, so the aleph is not found
788	there. A second point: the Torah is written without vowel marks, one can
789	read "venitmetem" and one can read "venitamtem,"
790	from the language of "atimut" (blocking): when a person eats non-kosher food, his spiritual dimension
791	is dulled. Afterwards he doesn't understand why
792	he has no spiritual sensitivity in certain areas,
793	though he wants to rise spiritually. And if he ate
794	non-kosher food in the past, let him repent for it, in order
795	to be freed from this shell that dulls him because of
796	the non-kosher things he ate in the past. He regrets the past,
797	accepts for the future, confesses, and he can be purified
798	and cleansed of this stain of the non-kosher things
